1	# Dynamic Island + `⌘P` — Implementation Specification
     2	
     3	> Implementation companion to `OCEAN_DESKTOP_NORTH_STAR.md`.
     4	>
     5	> Scope: define the smallest complete first build of Ocean Desktop's Dynamic
     6	> Island and its keyboard-first session focus/search mode. This is deliberately
     7	> concrete: data contracts, components, files, state transitions, keyboard
     8	> routing, CSS geometry, acceptance checks, and explicitly deferred work.
     9	>
    10	> The practical delivery sequence and commit gates live in
    11	> [`OCEAN_DYNAMIC_ISLAND_BUILD_PLAN.md`](OCEAN_DYNAMIC_ISLAND_BUILD_PLAN.md).
    12	
    13	## Decision summary
    14	
    15	Build this before a permanent left rail.
    16	
    17	The first release is **not** a generalized desktop task system. It is a
    18	Tauri-only, titlebar-adjacent focus surface backed by the existing daemon
    19	session catalogue.
    20	
    21	### V1 ships
    22	
    23	- compact Dynamic Island in the desktop header
    24	- focused session identity plus a count of active-background sessions
    25	- click to open an Island overlay
    26	- overlay lists active/recent sessions with project/path/branch/origin metadata
    27	- selecting a result calls the existing `Daemon::switch_session(id, title)` and
    28	  moves that session into the center transcript
    29	- `⌘P` opens that same overlay in search mode
    30	- fuzzy search over existing session metadata
    31	- arrow keys, Enter, Escape, click-outside behavior
    32	
    33	### V1 does not ship
    34	
    35	- inline reply to a background session
    36	- cross-session live streaming in the Island
    37	- server-side/session-content semantic search
    38	- approvals, CI, GitHub, browser, rooms, Council, files, or PR results
    39	- a left rail
    40	- a replacement for the existing web/extension Sessions modal
    41	
    42	Those are follow-on waves after the core focus interaction is proven.
    43	
    44	## Existing foundations to reuse
    45	
    46	Do not recreate these systems:
    47	
    48	| Existing implementation | Reuse in Island work |
    49	| --- | --- |
    50	| `Daemon::sessions: RwSignal<Vec<SessionSummary>>` | search corpus and list data |
    51	| `Daemon::session_id: RwSignal<Option<String>>` | focused-session identity |
    52	| `Daemon::switch_session(id, title)` | sole session focus/switch operation |
    53	| `sessions.rs::split_origin`, `fmt_relative_time`, `session_root`, project lookup | display metadata and normalized search text |
    54	| `palette.rs::fuzzy_score` behavior | fuzzy scoring semantics; extract/move to a shared search helper rather than copy it |
    55	| `PaletteView` keyboard pattern | input autofocus, ArrowUp/Down, Enter, Escape, backdrop click |
    56	| `app.rs` `window_event_listener(ev::keydown, ...)` | `⌘P` global shortcut and overlay Escape priority |
    57	| `host::running_in_tauri()` | mount/gating boundary |
    58	| `styles/chrome.css` titlebar model | titlebar position and drag-region rules |
    59	
    60	Important fact: today `Daemon::switch_session` replaces the active transcript
    61	and reconnects its SSE/permission streams. The Island must call it; it must not
    62	attempt a second transcript/session runtime of its own.
    63	
    64	## User-facing model
    65	
    66	### Terminology
    67	
    68	- **Focused session**: the daemon's current `session_id`; it owns the center
    69	  transcript and composer.
    70	- **Background session**: any other persisted session in the catalogue. V1
    71	  treats "recent" as the only reliable activity signal.
    72	- **Island**: compact titlebar control plus its expanded overlay.
    73	- **Search mode**: overlay opened by `⌘P`, with input focused.
    74	- **Browse mode**: overlay opened by click, with input present but not focused
    75	  or visually secondary.
    76	
    77	Do not call every session "active" in V1. The client currently observes an SSE
    78	stream only for the focused session, so it cannot truthfully determine whether
    79	other sessions are presently generating work. Use **recent sessions** until the
    80	daemon publishes cross-session activity.
    81	
    82	### V1 interaction flow
    83	
    84	```text
    85	Focused center session: A
    86	Catalogue: A, B, C, D
    87	
    88	header Island (closed)
    89	  [ A · Ocean Surface · 3 recent ]
    90	
    91	click Island OR press ⌘P
    92	  → Island overlay opens
    93	  → list shows A, B, C, D ordered by focus/recentness
    94	
    95	choose B + Enter/click
    96	  → Daemon::switch_session(B.id, B.title)
    97	  → B becomes focused center session
    98	  → overlay closes
    99	  → A remains in the catalogue and appears in future Island results
   100	```
   101	
   102	No extra "slotting" persistence is needed for V1. The natural catalogue order
   103	already makes the old focused session available. Explicit pins/orbits can arrive
   104	later only if observed usage requires them.
   105	
   106	## Data model
   107	
   108	Create a new `crates/ocean-surface-ui/src/island.rs` module.
   109	
   110	### Core types
   111	
   112	```rust
   113	#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
   114	pub enum IslandMode {
   115	    Closed,
   116	    Browse,
   117	    Search,
   118	}
   119	
   120	#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, PartialOrd, Ord)]
   121	pub enum IslandPriority {
   122	    Focused,
   123	    Recent,
   124	    Background,
   125	}
   126	
   127	#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq)]
   128	pub struct IslandSession {
   129	    pub id: String,
   130	    pub title: String,
   131	    pub project: Option<String>,
   132	    pub cwd: String,
   133	    pub branch: Option<String>,
   134	    pub origin: Option<String>,
   135	    pub updated_at: String,
   136	    pub turn_count: u32,
   137	    pub is_focused: bool,
   138	    pub priority: IslandPriority,
   139	}
   140	
   141	#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq)]
   142	pub enum IslandResult {
   143	    Session(IslandSession),
   144	}
   145	```
   146	
   147	Keep V1's result enum even though it has one variant. It establishes the
   148	extension seam for `Approval`, `BrowserTask`, `CiRun`, `File`, and `GitHubPull`
   149	without forcing speculative implementations today.
   150	
   151	### Derivation function
   152	
   153	Expose a pure function in `island.rs`:
   154	
   155	```rust
   156	pub(crate) fn derive_island_sessions(
   157	    sessions: &[SessionSummary],
   158	    projects: &[ProjectInfo],
   159	    focused_id: Option<&str>,
   160	) -> Vec<IslandSession>;
   161	```
   162	
   163	Rules:
   164	
   165	1. Retain every daemon-catalogued session, including zero-turn drafts. This
   166	   follows `sessions.rs::group_for_panel` parity.
   167	2. Resolve project display name via `owning_project`, then `project_for_root`.
   168	3. Parse `[WEB]`, `[?]`, etc. title prefix using a reusable public helper from
   169	   `sessions.rs` or a new shared metadata module. Do not duplicate parsing.
   170	4. Sort:
   171	   - focused session first,
   172	   - then `updated_at` newest-first,
   173	   - stable tie-breaker by title/id.
   174	5. `priority` is `Focused` for focused session; `Recent` for sessions updated
   175	   in the existing `is_recent` window; `Background` otherwise.
   176	6. No claims about remote/live activity in V1.
   177	
   178	### Search document and scoring
   179	
   180	Create a testable pure helper:
   181	
   182	```rust
   183	pub(crate) fn island_search_text(item: &IslandSession) -> String;
   184	pub(crate) fn search_island(
   185	    query: &str,
   186	    items: &[IslandSession],
   187	) -> Vec<IslandResult>;
   188	```
   189	
   190	Search text joins, lowercased, with separators:
   191	
   192	```text
   193	title project cwd branch origin state turns
   194	```
   195	
   196	Examples that must work:
   197	
   198	```text
   199	north star
   200	project:ocean-surface      // V1 literal text match is enough; facets deferred
   201	src/app.rs
   202	main
   203	tauri
   204	recent
   205	```
   206	
   207	Scoring:
   208	
   209	- empty query: existing derivation order
   210	- exact/prefix match in title: strongest boost
   211	- project match: second boost
   212	- cwd/branch/origin: normal fuzzy score
   213	- focused item: tie-break boost, not enough to hide better matches
   214	- recency: tie-break boost
   215	
   216	Extract `palette.rs::fuzzy_score` and the word-boundary helper into either:
   217	
   218	- `src/search.rs` (recommended), or
   219	- `pub(crate)` helpers in `palette.rs`
   220	
   221	Use the same scorer rather than making `⌘P` feel inconsistent with `⌘K`.
   222	
   223	## Component API and ownership
   224	
   225	### `Island` component
   226	
   227	```rust
   228	#[component]
   229	pub fn Island(
   230	    daemon: Daemon,
   231	    mode: RwSignal<IslandMode>,
   232	) -> impl IntoView
   233	```
   234	
   235	`app.rs` owns `mode`, because it coordinates:
   236	
   237	- header click
   238	- `⌘P`
   239	- global Escape ordering
   240	- any future deep links / menu actions
   241	
   242	`Island` owns local overlay state:
   243	
   244	```rust
   245	let query = RwSignal::new(String::new());
   246	let selected_index = RwSignal::new(0usize);
   247	let input_ref = NodeRef::<leptos::html::Input>::new();
   248	```
   249	
   250	### Required component DOM shape
   251	
   252	```text
   253	section.island-host                    // mounted inside .ocean-header
   254	  button.island-chip                   // compact/default state
   255	    focused session identity
   256	    background/recent count
   257	    state dot
   258	  Show(mode != Closed)
   259	    div.island-scrim                   // full window click target, below header
   260	    section.island-popover             // anchored below chip

   142	/// Search the Island corpus while preserving derivation order for an empty
   143	/// query and using focus/recency only as small tie-breaks for real queries.
   144	pub(crate) fn search_island(query: &str, items: &[IslandSession]) -> Vec<IslandResult> {
   145	    let query = query.trim();
   146	    if query.is_empty() {
   147	        return items.iter().cloned().map(IslandResult::Session).collect();
   148	    }
   149	
   150	    let query_lower = query.to_lowercase();
   151	    let mut scored: Vec<(u8, f64, usize, IslandSession)> = items
   152	        .iter()
   153	        .enumerate()
   154	        .filter_map(|(index, item)| {
   155	            let document_score = fuzzy_score(query, &island_search_text(item))?;
   156	            let title = item.title.to_lowercase();
   157	            let title_score = fuzzy_score(query, &item.title);
   158	            let project = item.project.as_deref().map(str::to_lowercase);
   159	            let project_score = project
   160	                .as_deref()
   161	                .and_then(|project| fuzzy_score(query, project));
   162	
   163	            // Match category is a strict tier; fuzzy score only orders items
   164	            // inside a tier, so a long fuzzy title can never outrank an exact
   165	            // project (and metadata can never outrank a title/project match).
   166	            let (tier, mut score) = if title == query_lower {
   167	                (6, title_score.unwrap_or(document_score))
   168	            } else if title.starts_with(&query_lower) {
   169	                (5, title_score.unwrap_or(document_score))
   170	            } else if project.as_deref() == Some(query_lower.as_str()) {
   171	                (4, project_score.unwrap_or(document_score))
   172	            } else if project
   173	                .as_deref()
   174	                .is_some_and(|project| project.starts_with(&query_lower))
   175	            {
   176	                (3, project_score.unwrap_or(document_score))
   177	            } else if let Some(title_score) = title_score {
   178	                (2, title_score)
   179	            } else if let Some(project_score) = project_score {
   180	                (1, project_score)
   181	            } else {
   182	                (0, document_score)
   183	            };
   184	            score += match item.priority {
   185	                IslandPriority::Focused => 2.0,
   186	                IslandPriority::Recent => 1.0,
   187	                IslandPriority::Background => 0.0,
   188	            };
   189	            Some((tier, score, index, item.clone()))
   190	        })
   191	        .collect();
   192	
   193	    scored.sort_by(|a, b| {
   194	        b.0.cmp(&a.0)
   195	            .then_with(|| b.1.partial_cmp(&a.1).unwrap_or(std::cmp::Ordering::Equal))
   196	            .then_with(|| a.2.cmp(&b.2))
   197	            .then_with(|| a.3.id.cmp(&b.3.id))
   198	    });
   199	    scored
   200	        .into_iter()
   201	        .map(|(_, _, _, item)| IslandResult::Session(item))
   202	        .collect()
   203	}

     1	//! Shared fuzzy matching for keyboard-first Ocean search surfaces.
     2	
     3	/// Score a case-insensitive subsequence match.
     4	///
     5	/// Matches at the start of the target, word boundaries, consecutive runs, and
     6	/// prefixes receive bonuses. `None` means the query is not a subsequence.
     7	pub(crate) fn fuzzy_score(query: &str, target: &str) -> Option<f64> {
     8	    if query.is_empty() {
     9	        return Some(0.0);
    10	    }
    11	
    12	    let query_lower = query.to_lowercase();
    13	    let target_lower = target.to_lowercase();
    14	    let query_chars: Vec<char> = query_lower.chars().collect();
    15	    let target_chars: Vec<char> = target_lower.chars().collect();
    16	    // Boundary detection needs the original case so camelCase transitions
    17	    // survive normalization.
    18	    let target_orig: Vec<char> = target.chars().collect();
    19	
    20	    let mut score = 0.0;
    21	    let mut qi = 0usize;
    22	    let mut prev_match = None;
    23	    let mut consecutive = 0usize;
    24	
    25	    for (ti, tc) in target_chars.iter().enumerate() {
    26	        if qi >= query_chars.len() {
    27	            break;
    28	        }
    29	        if *tc != query_chars[qi] {
    30	            continue;
    31	        }
    32	
    33	        let mut char_score = 1.0;
    34	        if ti == 0 {
    35	            char_score += 10.0;
    36	        }
    37	        if ti < target_orig.len() && is_word_boundary(&target_orig, ti) {
    38	            char_score += 5.0;
    39	        }
    40	        if let Some(prev) = prev_match {
    41	            if ti == prev + 1 {
    42	                consecutive += 1;
    43	                char_score += 2.0 * consecutive as f64;
    44	            } else {
    45	                consecutive = 0;
    46	            }
    47	        }
    48	        if qi == ti {
    49	            char_score += 3.0;
    50	        }
    51	
    52	        score += char_score;
    53	        prev_match = Some(ti);
    54	        qi += 1;
    55	    }
    56	
    57	    (qi == query_chars.len()).then_some(score)
    58	}

    60	/// Whether `chars[idx]` begins a word: index zero, after a separator, or at a
    61	/// lower-to-upper camelCase transition.
    62	pub(crate) fn is_word_boundary(chars: &[char], idx: usize) -> bool {
    63	    if idx == 0 {
    64	        return true;
    65	    }
    66	    let prev = chars[idx - 1];
    67	    let curr = chars[idx];
    68	    matches!(prev, ' ' | '-' | '_' | '/' | '.') || (prev.is_lowercase() && curr.is_uppercase())
    69	}

     2	
     3	> Implementation companion to `OCEAN_DESKTOP_NORTH_STAR.md`.
     4	>
     5	> Scope: define the smallest complete first build of Ocean Desktop's Dynamic
     6	> Island and its keyboard-first session focus/search mode. This is deliberately
     7	> concrete: data contracts, components, files, state transitions, keyboard
     8	> routing, CSS geometry, acceptance checks, and explicitly deferred work.
     9	>
    10	> The practical delivery sequence and commit gates live in
    11	> [`OCEAN_DYNAMIC_ISLAND_BUILD_PLAN.md`](OCEAN_DYNAMIC_ISLAND_BUILD_PLAN.md).
    12	
    13	## Decision summary
    14	
    15	Build this before a permanent left rail.
    16	
    17	The first release is **not** a generalized desktop task system. It is a
    18	Tauri-only, titlebar-adjacent focus surface backed by the existing daemon
    19	session catalogue.
    20	
    21	### V1 ships
    22	
    23	- compact Dynamic Island in the desktop header
    24	- focused session identity plus a count of active-background sessions
    25	- click to open an Island overlay
    26	- overlay lists active/recent sessions with project/path/branch/origin metadata
    27	- selecting a result calls the existing `Daemon::switch_session(id, title)` and
    28	  moves that session into the center transcript
    29	- `⌘P` opens that same overlay in search mode
    30	- fuzzy search over existing session metadata
    31	- arrow keys, Enter, Escape, click-outside behavior
    32	
    33	### V1 does not ship
    34	
    35	- inline reply to a background session
    36	- cross-session live streaming in the Island
    37	- server-side/session-content semantic search
    38	- approvals, CI, GitHub, browser, rooms, Council, files, or PR results
    39	- a left rail
    40	- a replacement for the existing web/extension Sessions modal
    41	
    42	Those are follow-on waves after the core focus interaction is proven.
    43	
    44	## Existing foundations to reuse
    45	
    46	Do not recreate these systems:
    47	
    48	| Existing implementation | Reuse in Island work |
    49	| --- | --- |
    50	| `Daemon::sessions: RwSignal<Vec<SessionSummary>>` | search corpus and list data |
    51	| `Daemon::session_id: RwSignal<Option<String>>` | focused-session identity |
    52	| `Daemon::switch_session(id, title)` | sole session focus/switch operation |
    53	| `sessions.rs::split_origin`, `fmt_relative_time`, `session_root`, project lookup | display metadata and normalized search text |
    54	| `palette.rs::fuzzy_score` behavior | fuzzy scoring semantics; extract/move to a shared search helper rather than copy it |
    55	| `PaletteView` keyboard pattern | input autofocus, ArrowUp/Down, Enter, Escape, backdrop click |
    56	| `app.rs` `window_event_listener(ev::keydown, ...)` | `⌘P` global shortcut and overlay Escape priority |
    57	| `host::running_in_tauri()` | mount/gating boundary |
    58	| `styles/chrome.css` titlebar model | titlebar position and drag-region rules |
    59	
    60	Important fact: today `Daemon::switch_session` replaces the active transcript
    61	and reconnects its SSE/permission streams. The Island must call it; it must not
    62	attempt a second transcript/session runtime of its own.
    63	
    64	## User-facing model
    65	
    66	### Terminology
    67	
    68	- **Focused session**: the daemon's current `session_id`; it owns the center
    69	  transcript and composer.
    70	- **Background session**: any other persisted session in the catalogue. V1
    71	  treats "recent" as the only reliable activity signal.
    72	- **Island**: compact titlebar control plus its expanded overlay.
    73	- **Search mode**: overlay opened by `⌘P`, with input focused.
    74	- **Browse mode**: overlay opened by click, with input present but not focused
    75	  or visually secondary.
    76	
    77	Do not call every session "active" in V1. The client currently observes an SSE
    78	stream only for the focused session, so it cannot truthfully determine whether
    79	other sessions are presently generating work. Use **recent sessions** until the
    80	daemon publishes cross-session activity.
    81	
    82	### V1 interaction flow
    83	
    84	```text
    85	Focused center session: A
    86	Catalogue: A, B, C, D
    87	
    88	header Island (closed)
    89	  [ A · Ocean Surface · 3 recent ]
    90	
    91	click Island OR press ⌘P
    92	  → Island overlay opens
    93	  → list shows A, B, C, D ordered by focus/recentness
    94	
    95	choose B + Enter/click
    96	  → Daemon::switch_session(B.id, B.title)
    97	  → B becomes focused center session
    98	  → overlay closes
    99	  → A remains in the catalogue and appears in future Island results
   100	```

   102	No extra "slotting" persistence is needed for V1. The natural catalogue order
   103	already makes the old focused session available. Explicit pins/orbits can arrive
   104	later only if observed usage requires them.

   152	
   153	Expose a pure function in `island.rs`:
   154	
   155	```rust

   142	/// Search the Island corpus while preserving derivation order for an empty
   143	/// query and using focus/recency only as small tie-breaks for real queries.
   144	pub(crate) fn search_island(query: &str, items: &[IslandSession]) -> Vec<IslandResult> {
   145	    let query = query.trim();
   146	    if query.is_empty() {
   147	        return items.iter().cloned().map(IslandResult::Session).collect();
   148	    }
   149	
   150	    let query_lower = query.to_lowercase();
   151	    let mut scored: Vec<(u8, f64, usize, IslandSession)> = items
   152	        .iter()
   153	        .enumerate()
   154	        .filter_map(|(index, item)| {
   155	            let document_score = fuzzy_score(query, &island_search_text(item))?;
   156	            let title = item.title.to_lowercase();
   157	            let title_score = fuzzy_score(query, &item.title);
   158	            let project = item.project.as_deref().map(str::to_lowercase);
   159	            let project_score = project
   160	                .as_deref()
   161	                .and_then(|project| fuzzy_score(query, project));
   162	
   163	            // Match category is a strict tier; fuzzy score only orders items
   164	            // inside a tier, so a long fuzzy title can never outrank an exact
   165	            // project (and metadata can never outrank a title/project match).
   166	            let (tier, mut score) = if title == query_lower {
   167	                (6, title_score.unwrap_or(document_score))
   168	            } else if title.starts_with(&query_lower) {
   169	                (5, title_score.unwrap_or(document_score))
   170	            } else if project.as_deref() == Some(query_lower.as_str()) {
   171	                (4, project_score.unwrap_or(document_score))
   172	            } else if project
   173	                .as_deref()
   174	                .is_some_and(|project| project.starts_with(&query_lower))
   175	            {
   176	                (3, project_score.unwrap_or(document_score))
   177	            } else if let Some(title_score) = title_score {
   178	                (2, title_score)
   179	            } else if let Some(project_score) = project_score {
   180	                (1, project_score)
   181	            } else {
   182	                (0, document_score)
   183	            };
   184	            score += match item.priority {
   185	                IslandPriority::Focused => 2.0,
   186	                IslandPriority::Recent => 1.0,
   187	                IslandPriority::Background => 0.0,
   188	            };
   189	            Some((tier, score, index, item.clone()))
   190	        })
   191	        .collect();
   192	
   193	    scored.sort_by(|a, b| {
   194	        b.0.cmp(&a.0)
   195	            .then_with(|| b.1.partial_cmp(&a.1).unwrap_or(std::cmp::Ordering::Equal))
   196	            .then_with(|| a.2.cmp(&b.2))
   197	            .then_with(|| a.3.id.cmp(&b.3.id))
   198	    });
   199	    scored
   200	        .into_iter()
   201	        .map(|(_, _, _, item)| IslandResult::Session(item))
   202	        .collect()
   203	}

     1	//! Shared fuzzy matching for keyboard-first Ocean search surfaces.
     2	
     3	/// Score a case-insensitive subsequence match.
     4	///
     5	/// Matches at the start of the target, word boundaries, consecutive runs, and
     6	/// prefixes receive bonuses. `None` means the query is not a subsequence.
     7	pub(crate) fn fuzzy_score(query: &str, target: &str) -> Option<f64> {
     8	    if query.is_empty() {
     9	        return Some(0.0);
    10	    }
    11	
    12	    let query_lower = query.to_lowercase();
    13	    let target_lower = target.to_lowercase();
    14	    let query_chars: Vec<char> = query_lower.chars().collect();
    15	    let target_chars: Vec<char> = target_lower.chars().collect();
    16	    // Boundary detection needs the original case so camelCase transitions
    17	    // survive normalization.
    18	    let target_orig: Vec<char> = target.chars().collect();
    19	
    20	    let mut score = 0.0;
    21	    let mut qi = 0usize;
    22	    let mut prev_match = None;
    23	    let mut consecutive = 0usize;
    24	
    25	    for (ti, tc) in target_chars.iter().enumerate() {
    26	        if qi >= query_chars.len() {
    27	            break;
    28	        }
    29	        if *tc != query_chars[qi] {
    30	            continue;
    31	        }
    32	
    33	        let mut char_score = 1.0;
    34	        if ti == 0 {
    35	            char_score += 10.0;
    36	        }
    37	        if ti < target_orig.len() && is_word_boundary(&target_orig, ti) {
    38	            char_score += 5.0;
    39	        }
    40	        if let Some(prev) = prev_match {
    41	            if ti == prev + 1 {
    42	                consecutive += 1;
    43	                char_score += 2.0 * consecutive as f64;
    44	            } else {
    45	                consecutive = 0;
    46	            }
    47	        }
    48	        if qi == ti {
    49	            char_score += 3.0;
    50	        }
    51	
    52	        score += char_score;
    53	        prev_match = Some(ti);
    54	        qi += 1;
    55	    }
    56	
    57	    (qi == query_chars.len()).then_some(score)
    58	}

    60	/// Whether `chars[idx]` begins a word: index zero, after a separator, or at a

    62	pub(crate) fn is_word_boundary(chars: &[char], idx: usize) -> bool {

    66	    let prev = chars[idx - 1];
    67	    let curr = chars[idx];
    68	    matches!(prev, ' ' | '-' | '_' | '/' | '.') || (prev.is_lowercase() && curr.is_uppercase())
    69	}
